title: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Scheduling Operations Agent suggests optimised technician schedules
summary: Hold for corrections to the interactive resource limit and the description of expired bookings. Capacity points count towards the five-resource limit, and the time-window option removes a booking from the suggested schedule rather than immediately deleting the live booking. The roadmap facts, opt-in requirement and consumption billing are supported.

claims.where: controls[2].api; Governance controls table; Governance controls prose
claims.claim: The writable bookingstatus column msdyn_optimizationmethod uses 192350000 for Optimize, 192350001 for Do Not Move and 192350002 for Ignore.
claims.quote:
LogicalName | msdyn_optimizationmethod
192350000 | Optimize
192350001 | Do Not Move
192350002 | Ignore
claims.fix: The metadata is correct, but 'Set the ... column' is not a runnable call. Replace the API text with 'PATCH [Organization URI]/api/data/v9.2/bookingstatuses(<booking status ID>) with Content-Type: application/json, If-Match: * and body {"msdyn_optimizationmethod":192350000}' and note that this example selects Optimize. The endpoint is documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/developer/reference/entities/bookingstatus and PATCH syntax at https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/developer/data-platform/webapi/update-delete-entities-using-web-api. Retain the cited Field Service reference for the column and option values.
